THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

I, Nalaka Jude Harin Fernando, Minister of Tourism and Lands, do hereby announce under Sub section (1) of Section 5 of Land Acquisition Act, that the Government intends to acquire the following land that necessary for the construction of Village Secretariat at Pamunuwa under the ordinance of the Lands acquisition Act.

Following described plot of land denoted by following names and extents that shown in Surveyor Generals’ Advance Tracing No. Ma/YTT/2022/228 dated 12.09.2022 situated at Pamunuwa village in Pamunuwa GN division (E 339) of
Yatawatta DS division of Matale District in Central Province is bounded on:

01. Lot ‘A’ – Wediyakpitiyahena, Hapugahamulapitiya, Vedakara Gedara Pahala Watta – Extent: 0.0153 Hectare North : Road and Wediyakpitiya Hena, Hapugahamula Pitiya and Vedakara Gedara Pahala Watta claimed by K. M. Asoka Pamunuwa and Others; East: Wediyakpitiya Hena, Hapugahamula Pitiya and Vedakara Gedara Pahala Watta claimed by K. M. Asoka Pamunuwa and Others and Gedaragawa Watta claimed by D. P. K. Senarathna; South: Gedaragawa Watta claimed by D. P. K. Senarathna and Wediyakpitiya Hena, Hapugahamula Pitiya and Vedakara Gedara Pahala Watta claimed by K. M. Ashoka Pamunuwa
